rows.definition: metalgemm's device prefill attention: a tiled simdgroup-MMA causal GQA kernel that computes softmax(scale*q.k^T)v for a P-row prefill panel against the layer's whole f32 KV cache on the GPU, one threadgroup per 8 query rows and GQA group (fak#13695).
rows.distinction: attnPrefillInto is the host CPU loop and parity oracle for the same math; PrefillAttention is its GPU twin, and attnPrefillDispatch chooses between them.
